parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.language, s.id AS scene_id, s.scene_number, s.title AS scene_title, s.summary, s.characters_present, s.location, s.time_period, s.emotional_tone, s.word_count, s.production_metadata, c.chapter_number FROM projects p JOIN scenes s ON p.id = s.project_id JOIN chapters c ON s.chapter_id = c.id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state = 'planned' ORDER BY c.chapter_number, s.scene_number

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "{{ $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3' }}",
  "prompt": "You are a cinematic shot planner. For each scene below, generate a detailed shot list.

Project: '{{ $('Execute Logic').item.json.title }}'

Scenes: {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Logic').item.json.batches[0]) }}

For each scene, generate:
1. total_shots: number of shots
2. shot_budget: estimated cost tier (low/medium/high)
3. shots: array of {
     shot_id: unique string,
     shot_number: sequential int,
     shot_type: {wide, medium, close-up, extreme-close-up, over-shoulder, pov, aerial, tracking},
     duration_seconds: estimated duration,
     description: what happens in the shot,
     characters_in_shot: array of character names,
     camera_movement: {static, pan, tilt, dolly, zoom, handheld, steadicam, crane},
     transition_in: {cut, dissolve, fade-in, wipe, match-cut},
     transition_out: {cut, dissolve, fade-out, wipe, match-cut},
     priority: {critical, high, medium, low},
     vfx_required: boolean,
     dialogue_in_shot: boolean
   }

Return as JSON array with scene_id as key for each entry.",
  "stream": false,
  "format": "json"
}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO shots (scene_id, project_id, shot_number, shot_type, duration_seconds, description, characters_in_shot, camera_movement, transition_in, transition_out, priority, vfx_required, dialogue_in_shot, state, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14, NOW())
UPDATE projects SET state = 'shot_planned', total_shots = $2, estimated_duration_seconds = $3, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'shots_planned', $2::jsonb, NOW())

values.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ state: 'shot_planned', total_shots: $('Execute Logic (Shots)').item.json.total_shots, total_scenes: $('Execute Logic (Shots)').item.json.total_scenes, estimated_duration: $('Execute Logic (Shots)').item.json.total_duration_formatted }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'shot_planned', project_id: $('Execute Logic (Shots)').item.json.project_id, total_shots: $('Execute Logic (Shots)').item.json.total_shots, estimated_duration: $('Execute Logic (Shots)').item.json.total_duration_formatted }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', message: 'Project not in planned state or no scenes found' }) }}
